title: Use a Temporary Directory
question: Create a temporary directory that is cleaned up automatically.
code:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / 'note.txt'
    path.write_text('Temporary', encoding='utf-8')
    print(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
explanation: TemporaryDirectory removes its contents when the context ends.
